question: The prime themes of Kathak are tied to which of the following cults of Hinduism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishnavism​.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vaishnavite cult which swept North India in the **15th **century. and the resultant bhakti movement contributed to a whole new range of lyrics and musical forms.
 
• The Radha-Krishna theme proved immensely popular alongwith the works of Mirabai, Surdas, Nandadas and Krishnadas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhism** is a **non-theistic religion** that originated in ancient India and emphasizes the** teachings of Buddha.**
 
• **Shaktism** is a tradition of Hinduism that worships the **divine feminine energy,** or Shakti, as the supreme deity.
